editorialLimits: Explicit user canon and established quest narration/outcomes govern. Character statements remain attributed; older unchanged histories retain their earlier review scope.

Discovery and exported working windows are not exhaustive archive reading. The 172 cited versions, not every cached message, are verified. Original payload timestamps and distinct API/export versions remain exact.

The Holy Road pilgrimage includes a night in the snow before dawn and another hour of ascent. The recorded opening date is not evidence that the complete narrated journey occurred without a night. No unsupported new posting day is invented.
A request for mental openness permits a visitor to keep his mind private. The city approach does not disclose private inner revelations, the keepers’ hidden nature or ancient origins.

The November castle quest names Caselean; the earlier unnamed castle remains a qualified association. The narrator corrects the specific meteor allegation, not every accusation. Bowene rejects the exile proposal at this hearing; the later December exile remains a separate outcome.

The Tomb of Heroes stands in Seraphis outside Ciaránach. The procession begins at the castle, passes Zarathis and takes hours. A closing silence seems a night but is explicitly one hour; it does not add a new calendar day.

Rahuvia’s journey distinguishes a presumed border, road, overnight escort, pond, gates, valley and capital. The Queen’s negotiation and sanctuary are bounded events, not blanket immunity. Yoshida’s workshop and Cecil/Talon’s embassy pond have no established capital address and remain unplaced.

The Pristinia library has a scant early collection, a dark main-quest reading room and a later newspaper search. A construction inquiry establishes useful library work, not a completed design or building. Subsequent restricted-room content is excluded.

The Before survey begins outside Pristinia and reaches a known sinkhole. Miri’s attempted Common Sign Language introduction is not understood; written clarification follows. The scholars’ barrier and Camilla’s blast help a retreat. A proposed camp is not a completed overnight stay. Ancient origin histories and protected procedures remain private.

All 391 timeline identities, posting/calendar bounds, importance, participants and regions remain. Four existing records gain precise geography/context or a narrated-night note. No new event or story page is created.

Eight individual directory rows change without conflating the city, Holy Road and temple, or the Before entrance and caverns. The temple row is exact. All old section titles/bookmarks, assets and unrelated records remain.

No raw transcripts, controller information, rules tables, unreviewed attachments, private origin identities, laboratory/keeper secrets or generic/joke NPCs enter Git. Public receipts contain only source identities, timestamps, hashes and bounded editorial descriptions.
